ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: In the image, on the left is wheel A; at the beginning only the wheel core is drawn, with the radius marked as r. On the right is wheel B; the wheel-core radius is also marked as r, and outside there is a shaded ring indicating the magnetic-tape layer, with the outer-edge radius marked as R. The magnetic tape connects from wheel B on the right to wheel A on the left, and the arrow v indicates that during rewinding the magnetic tape moves toward wheel A. The problem states that R=3r; during rewinding wheel A is the driving wheel and its angular velocity is constant; the time required to rewind all of it onto wheel A is t. Let when rewinding has proceeded to time τ, the outer-edge radius of the magnetic tape on wheel A be x, and the outer-edge radius of the magnetic tape on wheel B be y. The thickness of the magnetic tape is uniform, and the length of the magnetic tape is proportional to the wound cross-sectional area, so the total amount of magnetic tape is conserved: π(x^2-r^2)+π(y^2-r^2)=π(R^2-r^2). Therefore x^2+y^2=R^2+r^2=(3r)^2+r^2=10r^2. The angular velocity of wheel A is constant; let it be ω_A. The tape-taking linear velocity of wheel A is v=ω_A x. On the other hand, the rate of increase of the wound area on wheel A is 2πx dx/dτ, which is proportional to the rate of length of magnetic tape taken in, so dx/dτ is a constant. Therefore x increases linearly with time: at the beginning τ=0, x=r; at the end τ=t, x=R=3r, so x=r+(3r-r)τ/t=r+2rτ/t. When the angular velocities of wheels A and B are equal, by the no-slipping condition, the same magnetic-tape linear velocity satisfies v=ω_A x=ω_B y. If ω_A=ω_B, then it must be that x=y. Substituting into the conservation formula gives 2x^2=10r^2, so x=√5 r. Substituting again into x=r+2rτ/t gives √5 r=r+2rτ/t, and solving gives τ=((√5-1)/2)t.

method.method_draft: 先从图中读出：左轮A开始几乎只有轮芯半径r，右轮B上有阴影磁带层，外缘半径R，磁带从B绕向A，标有线速度v；图中A、B轮芯半径相同均为r。结合题文给出的R=3r、A轮角速度恒定、总倒带时间为t。设倒带进行时间为τ时，A轮外缘半径为x，B轮外缘半径为y。用磁带长度守恒（磁带厚度均匀，长度与卷绕截面积成正比）得(x^2-r^2)+(y^2-r^2)=R^2-r^2，即x^2+y^2=R^2+r^2=10r^2。又因A轮角速度恒定，A轮收带线速度v=ω_A x，磁带长度增加率与x成正比，而卷绕面积增加率也为2x dx/dτ，故dx/dτ为常量，所以x从r线性增至3r，得到x=r+2rτ/t。两轮角速度相等时，同一磁带线速度满足v=ω_A x=ω_B y，因此ω_A=ω_B推出x=y。代入长度守恒得2x^2=10r^2，x=√5r。再由x=r+2rτ/t解出τ=((√5-1)/2)t。

In the image, on the left is wheel A; at the beginning only the wheel core is drawn, with the radius marked as r. On the right is wheel B; the wheel-core radius is also marked as r, and outside there is a shaded ring indicating the magnetic-tape layer, with the outer-edge radius marked as R. The magnetic tape connects from wheel B on the right to wheel A on the left, and the arrow v indicates that during rewinding the magnetic tape moves toward wheel A. The problem states that R=3r; during rewinding wheel A is the driving wheel and its angular velocity is constant; the time required to rewind all of it onto wheel A is t.

Therefore x^2+y^2=R^2+r^2=(3r)^2+r^2=10r^2.

The angular velocity of wheel A is constant; let it be ω_A. The tape-taking linear velocity of wheel A is v=ω_A x. On the other hand, the rate of increase of the wound area on wheel A is 2πx dx/dτ, which is proportional to the rate of length of magnetic tape taken in, so dx/dτ is a constant. Therefore x increases linearly with time: at the beginning τ=0, x=r; at the end τ=t, x=R=3r, so x=r+(3r-r)τ/t=r+2rτ/t.
